name: crash-ai-crashsight
title: CrashAI CrashSight MCP
description: Fast Rust-backed CrashSight fact collector. It scans CrashSight issue-list pages with upload-time early-stop and OpenAPI rate-limit protection, extracts tags/Redmine refs directly from list rows, enriches Redmine, and returns a direct Markdown report plus same-response context for Agent analysis.
author: AIINWORK
capabilities: Rust-backed CrashSight issue-list scanning with start/end hints, local upload-time filtering, and early-stop
Extracts CrashSight tagInfoList/tagName Redmine references directly from list rows
CrashSight OpenAPI 25/min limit protection with a conservative 20/min default
Direct Markdown report and same-response context output for Agent analysis
Issue rows are aggregated by issue, platform, and application version
Legacy CrashSight tools retained for compatibility

setupFields.label: CrashSight Region
setupFields.description: cn uses crashsight.qq.com; sg uses crashsight.wetest.net.

setupFields.label: CrashSight localUserId
setupFields.description: CrashSight OpenAPI localUserId. Stored only in local MCP config.

setupFields.label: CrashSight OpenAPI Key
setupFields.description: CrashSight OpenAPI userOpenapiKey. Stored only in local MCP config.

setupFields.label: Branch Filters JSON
setupFields.description: JSON map from branch name to CrashSight version wildcard.

setupFields.label: Redmine Base URL
setupFields.description: Base URL used to query and format Redmine issue links.

setupFields.label: Redmine API Key
setupFields.description: Optional Redmine API key for status and owner enrichment.

setupFields.label: CrashSight Concurrency
setupFields.description: Max concurrent CrashSight tasks. Actual OpenAPI starts are still rate-limited.

setupFields.label: CrashSight OpenAPI Rate
setupFields.description: CrashSight official limit is 25 requests/minute per user across all OpenAPI endpoints. Default 20/minute keeps headroom.

setupFields.label: CrashSight Retry Count
setupFields.description: Retries for 429/rate-limit/temporary 5xx responses before reporting a tool error.

setupFields.label: Rust Core Timeout ms
setupFields.description: Optional explicit Rust core timeout. Leave empty for adaptive timeout based on platforms, branches, maxPages, and OpenAPI rate limit.

setupFields.label: Fetch Missing Issue Details
setupFields.description: When true, fetch issueInfo for rows missing tags/Redmine refs. Default true prevents filed Redmine issues from being misclassified as unfiled.

setupFields.label: Use Server Date Filter
setupFields.description: Optional. CrashSight issueUploadTimeRelativeMillis can miss in-range issues on some projects, so the default is false. The MCP still sends start/end hints and filters by upload time with early-stop locally.
